The '''Minas Mud Dauber''' was a model of Y-Engine [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that was around during the [[Third Galactic War]]. [[Minas]] only released the Mud Dauber to a limited market, making the Mud Dauber a collector's item.<ref name="Bundle" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Minas Mud Dauber was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was added to the game in Game Update 7.7.1 as a reward for the Galactic Seasons 9 event.<ref name="update">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250730|text=Game Update 7.7.1 Livestream Recap}}</ref>
